text:
Afternoon care crew,
Crowded watch at the desk, and water breaks came up

Dear team,

I am asking for sharp attention across the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways today. We are carrying a heavy intake, and every record, crate note, and handoff detail must be checked before it leaves the desk. Do not rely on memory when a file is open. Read each booking line carefully, confirm the care notes, and keep the cabin team informed whenever a change appears. <<FACT F091>> Our tone with travelers must remain calm and exact, even when the line is long and the desk feels crowded.

Please escalate transfer issues without delay and document the reason clearly in the file. <<FACT F106>> If a traveler arrives with a pet that has special handling needs, raise the matter at once and make sure the next staff member can follow the trail without guessing. We are expected to keep movement safe, clear, and traceable from booking through pickup. Recheck carrier labels, feeding notes, and any instructions tied to the animal's comfort. If a detail is missing, stop and verify it before the case moves on. That standard protects the traveler, the pet, and the desk.

We also need firm attention on reptile cases. <<FACT F078>> Treat that rule as non-negotiable, and do not improvise around it in a busy moment. The safest path is the one that is fully documented and fully understood before handoff. Keep your notes brief, accurate, and complete. If you see confusion building at the counter, step in early, slow the process, and make the next action obvious. We cannot afford loose handling or vague communication when animals are depending on us.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
